svg.text: PT Neopangan Selaras Indonesia (Neofood) · Sauce Division · skema gabungan v1 + v2
PK primary key · FK foreign key · UQ unique · GEN generated column. FK audit ke profiles tidak digambar.
Alur inti: lots (asal-usul + halal + biaya) → handling_units (satu kemasan fisik = satu QR) → stock_movements (buku besar, append-only) → batch_consumption (jantung telusur mundur & HPP).
